message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the incoming data paths, config values, or loaded datasets anywhere in the code slice.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data paths are passed directly to generate_dataset without any checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks for remote or local sources.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline (dataloader.py, dataset generation) contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: The pretrained checkpoint is loaded via `load_from_checkpoint(pt_ckpt, **params)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision — the path is taken directly from config with no integrity validation.

No detected label distribution validation: While a WeightedRandomSampler is used to handle class imbalance, there is no explicit validation or check of the label distribution or expected label set before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor detection mechanisms such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: There is no use of differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test_loader is conditionally used for evaluation, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no multiple independent metrics reported, and no explicit isolation guarantee preventing test data leakage into training.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, type, or schema validation is performed on data before it is passed through the dataloader and into the model.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs (e.g., NaN guards, probability bounds, or threshold validation) anywhere in the inference/evaluation path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular data transformer model (SAINT), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
